visual_requirements.description: Long-haired youthful male, ivy crown and pinecone-tipped thyrsos; opaque robe.
Ship mast becomes huge vine; wine runs through ship; restraints fall away.

depicted_variant: Long-haired youthful Dionysus with thyrsos and ivy, overthrowing restraint on the pirate ship.
aura: Mast transformed into huge vine and ship streaming wine (dionysus-c28,c39), bonds fall away(c38).
artistic_choices: Fully opaque burgundy draped robe, not nude ancient imagery.
Lighting from sunset, no magic envelope.
Fore-shortened staff and close framing convey divine authority without unsupported giant anatomy.

prompts.A:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of Dionysus, Greek god of wine and vegetation in the pirate ship miracle.
ANATOMY: long-haired youthful male, one head two eyes two arms two legs, ivy wreath, LARGE obvious pinecone-tipped thyrsos staff, fully opaque dark burgundy robe covering torso and legs [dionysus-c04,c34].
POWER: ship's mast transforms into a huge tangible vine, sails drip wine, wine streams over deck and restraining cords fall loose from his wrist [dionysus-c28,c38,c39]. Thick woody green vines, NOT glowing ribbons.
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low close angle, young angular face and pinecone staff fill foreground; no gigantic human anatomy.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one dying gold sunset source, deep shadows, sea spray and snapping sail cloth.
SURFACE: wet splintered wood, rough ivy leaves, wine-dark fabric, real grape vines.
SETTING: deck of pirate ship with a mast now a huge woody vine [dionysus-c28,c39].
MOOD: ecstatic fierce divine authority, overwhelming, never ordinary or calm.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text/pseudo-glyphs anywhere on ship/clothes/staff, no logos/watermarks/borders, no extra anatomy, no film/game/anime design, no nudity/gore, no aura/neon/energy ribbons.
MOMENT: Dionysus drives thyrsos down into the wine-flooded deck, his loose bonds falling as vines engulf mast behind him, sharply intense eyes angled down at viewer; close confrontation with staff and face dominant.
